instruments.name: GPU Financing 2.0 (Mackenzie: MFSA term loan + senior secured notes, single instrument)
instruments.issuer_entity: IE Mackenzie Compute Ltd. (wholly owned BC subsidiary)
instruments.collateral: Financed GPUs and ancillary equipment at Mackenzie (BC); no parent security
instruments.guarantors: IREN Limited guarantees payment obligations (recourse to Parent)
instruments.amortization: Amortizes over 30 months from each tranche funding date; draws through 2026-12-31

source.quote: As of September 30, 2026, $947 million had been funded, $1,500 million of commitment remained available

instruments.notes: Signed 2026-08-25. Term loans and notes funded ratably on identical terms, presented as one instrument; split MFSA vs notes not disclosed. Commitment 2,447 per debt-issuance table ('up to $2.4 billion' in text) = 947 funded + 1,500 available (derived sum). Lender group (baseline 10-K): Blue Owl-led, PIMCO-advised notes. Cross-default / no financial maintenance covenants on parent per baseline.
